correctness.rationale: The norm-analytic square root at invertible A² yields AL+LA=i[A,B]; the Sylvester inverse fixes the derivative. The unilateral shift gives L=-P0/2, while explicit approximate eigenvectors give d_+(t)>=3(sqrt(1+4t²)-1). Finite truncations yield L_n=(P_{n-1}-P0)/2. All quantifiers, signs, boundary t=0 and noncommutativity have been checked analytically; 79 exact finite diagnostic identities supplement the proof.
